scenes.prompt: A bright neighborhood coffee shop window seat at mid-morning, shot on a 35mm lens at seated eye-level slight three-quarter so the diaper backpack sits upright on a small round marble café table in the front-left of a 1:1 frame. Natural light from a tall window at frame-left, soft and diffused. Style with a half-finished oat-milk latte in a tan stoneware cup with a smear of foam on the lip, a pacifier with a wooden clip resting on a folded muslin cloth napkin, a small chunky board book dog-eared at the corner, and the front wheel plus push-bar of a modern matte-black stroller just intruding into the back-right edge of the frame (mostly out of focus). Walls behind are a pale eucalyptus-green half-tile above warm white paint. The bag matches the reference exactly — the Oxford print and colour shown in the variant reference image, dual shoulder straps, top loop handle, front zip pocket, side mesh bottle pocket, magnetic top closure — sitting upright facing the camera. Palette of cream, oat, eucalyptus, blush brown, soft brass. Sharp focus on the bag, soft natural depth-of-field on the surroundings, no people, photographic and lived-in, no cinematic moodiness, no alcohol.
